jurisdiction.overview: Nationally published records appear separately from applicable EU-level records. The landscape, historical relationships and legal applicability remain under document-level review.

narrative.summary: Sudan has no AI law, AI strategy, data protection law or AI guidance. The Central Bank of Sudan's Five-Year Strategic Plan 2026-2030 plans the bank's own use of AI, and the Prime Minister's March 2026 directives on AI in education are published only as a Council of Ministers news item; both are tracked as leads. In July 2026 Sudan signed the founding agreement of the World Artificial Intelligence Cooperation Organization, which is also tracked as a lead until an official text or ratification act is published.
lead_institutions: Ministry of Telecommunications and Digital Transformation
narrative.review_notes: The telecoms regulator, digital ministry, Council of Ministers, justice ministry, central bank, national information centre and standards body were searched again in October 2026; the education ministry site could not be accessed, the health ministry site was offline, and many of the regulator's regulations are scanned images that could not be searched. The Prime Minister's AI-education directives, the central bank's plan and Sudan's signature of the World AI Cooperation Organization agreement remain leads pending official texts.

Units covered: Law: Ministry of Justice site (moj.gov.sd) law/regulation/decision indexes and MTDT Laws/Decrees/Regulations pages searched: no AI law, no AI provisions, no data protection law (Sudan has none) and no AI bill found; searched, nothing found.; Government: Ministry of Telecommunications and Digital Transformation (mtdt.gov.sd) Strategies/Policies/Plans/Programs sections: only placeholder PDFs, no national AI or digital strategy document online; Council of Ministers portal (sudan.gov.sd) and National Information Center (nic.gov.sd) home pages: nothing on AI. leads.title: توجيهات رئيس الوزراء التنفيذية بشأن تعليم الذكاء الاصطناعي ورقمنة القطاع الصحي وإدارة المشروعات القومية (مارس 2026)
leads.english_title: Prime Minister's executive directives on AI education, health-sector digitalisation and national project management (March 2026)
leads.issuing_authority: Prime Minister of Sudan (Council of Ministers)
leads.note: Reported (late March 2026) on the Embassy of Sudan in Berlin news blog and in press: Prime Minister Kamil Idris directed coordination with the Ministry of Higher Education to set up infrastructure for an AI bachelor's programme, a review of school curricula to incorporate AI, and digital education platforms, following a meeting with the Minister of Digital Transformation and Telecommunications. No official text of the directives was found on a Council of Ministers, ministry or gazette site on 2026-10-12; promote only if the directive text is published officially. 2026-10-18: the Council of Ministers portal carries a news item dated 31 March 2026 (https://sudan.gov.sd/رئيس-الوزراء،-البروفيسور-كامل-إدريس،/) describing the three directives (AI bachelor's programme and curriculum review with the Ministry of Higher Education, national project platform, hospital digitalisation). It is a news account of directives given in a meeting, not the directive text, so it stays a lead.

leads.english_title: Central Bank of Sudan Five-Year Strategic Plan 2026-2030 (Recovery and Strategic Transformation Plan)
leads.note: Moved to leads under the PROTOCOL §1 scope test: the plan sets out the Central Bank's own internal AI projects (monetary forecasting, operational data analysis, anti-money-laundering detection) and does not set rules or expectations for others. Official PDF: https://cbos.gov.sd/sites/default/files/strategic_plan_2026_2030.pdf (Governor's foreword dated 31 December 2025). Re-check for any AI guidance the bank issues to the financial sector. 2026-10-18: central bank home page reachable; its site search could not be run and no AI guidance to the financial sector was found on the listings checked.

leads.issuing_authority: Government of Sudan (signed by the Ambassador of Sudan to China)
leads.note: The Telecommunications and Post Regulatory Authority news page (https://tpra.gov.sd/السودان-يوقع-اتفاقية-إنشاء-المنظمة-ال/, dated Beijing 31 July 2026) states that Sudan signed the founding agreement of the World AI Cooperation Organization as a founding member, signed by Ambassador Omar Issa Ahmed on behalf of the Government. No treaty text, ratification act or decree was found on official Sudanese sites on 2026-10-18; record under 'international' once an official text or ratification act is published.
